title: Kato Dashboard v4 - Wabi-Sabi Edition
description: Clean, motion-rich dashboard with beige/granola aesthetic, opportunity scanning, and autonomous operation visibility

userStories.title: Wabi-Sabi Theme Implementation
userStories.description: Implement beige/granola color scheme with clean motion aesthetics
acceptanceCriteria: Cards: pure white with subtle shadow
Smooth transitions on all hover states
No harsh borders, use shadows and subtle dividers

userStories.title: Enhanced Opportunity Scanner
userStories.description: Improve opportunity detection with startup ideas, P0 prioritization, and external sources
acceptanceCriteria: P0 ROADMAP items always appear at top regardless of type
Detect startup ideas from patterns in projects
Twitter API integration for opportunity scanning (future)
Categorize opportunities: Blocker, Ready, Idea, Deadline, System

userStories.title: Subtask System
userStories.description: Implement hierarchical task system with subtask visibility
acceptanceCriteria: Progress bar calculated from subtask completion
Subtasks show in Kato's Queue when expanded
Click parent task to see all subtasks

userStories.title: Actions Panel
userStories.description: Create dedicated Actions section for pending decisions and opportunities
acceptanceCriteria: Shows P0 items waiting to start
Click to take action (if backend supports)
Dismissing removes from active view but keeps in history

userStories.title: System Tasks with Better Token Accuracy
userStories.description: Fix token logging accuracy and show system tasks appropriately
acceptanceCriteria: Debug and fix token stats accuracy
System tasks show in separate section
Token logging task shows last run time
Health check task shows last status

userStories.title: Historical Archive
userStories.description: Show historical opportunities and completed tasks

userStories.title: Message Bot Research
userStories.description: Research message bot UIs for inspiration
acceptanceCriteria: Document findings from Notion, Slack, Discord bot UIs
Identify patterns: command palettes, quick actions, rich cards
Reference: Notion AI, Slack shortcuts, Discord bot interactions
